 * Forward change requests / improvement suggestions to the developer in charge

Who we're looking for

Als erfolgreiches, international tätiges Familienunternehmen bietet ALPLA neben innovativen Produkten und modernsten Technologien auch internationale Entwicklungsperspektiven in einer Vielzahl unterschiedlicher Berufe. ALPLA ist global präsent und in 45 Ländern aktiv. Daher ist unser Unternehmen jederzeit an weltoffenen und sprachbegabten Talenten sowie Fach- und Führungskräften interessiert.

Werden sie mit uns zum Global Player und damit Teil des weltweiten Erfolgs von ALPLA.

Aktuell suchen wir: 1 Technical Key Account Manager (all gender) What you will enjoy doing

As Technical Key Account Manager, you are the strategic technical counterpart to some of ALPLA's most important global customers.

You connect customer ambitions with ALPLA's innovation and manufacturing capabilities and help shape long-term growth opportunities.

 * Own and actively lead the global technical relationship with assigned Strategic Key Customers

 * Build strong relationships across customer technical and development organizations

 * Technical ownership of request for quotations, ensuring technical feasibility, competitiveness and customer-focused solutions

 * Understand customer technology roadmaps and strategic priorities

 * Identify business opportunities and future business challenges

 * Partner closely with the Global Key Account Manager to translate customer strategies into growth opportunities

 * Escalation handling for technical topics in alignment with Global Key Account Manager

 * Coordinate and connect ALPLA functions including Product Development, Innovation Management, Recycling, Operations and Technical Centers

 * Develop and align global customer guidelines and technical standards

 * Lead customer workshops

 * Represent ALPLA in high-level technical discussions and strategic customer meetings

 * Global overview of customer project portfolio

What makes you great

 * Strong technical background (Product Development, Engineering, Operations or Packaging), experience in the rigid plastics industry is preferred

 * Experience in engaging with customers

 * Proactive, self-driven and structured working style

 * Able to connect customer strategy and business opportunities with ALPLA technical capabilities

 * Entrepreneurial mindset and passion for building long-term customer partnerships

 * Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken. German language skills are considered as an advantage

 * Willingness to travel frequently

What you can expect working with us

 * Be a part of a global family-owned enterprise 

 * A unique opportunity to shape and build strategic customer partnerships on a global scale

 * High visibility across customers, management and key decision-makers within ALPLA

 * A role where technical expertise, commercial thinking and leadership come together

 * Your performance is recognized: we invest in your growth with a wide range of development opportunities through the ALPLA Academy

 * ALPLA Kids full-day childcare for children aged 15 months to 6 years

 * Stay fit and healthy with the professional training offered by ALPLAsports

Legally mandatory note: In line with the minimum salary stipulated in the collective agreement, the actual salary for this position is based on professional qualifications and experience.

jobs.description:
We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Technical Customer Success Manager - DACH Market (m/f/d)

 Your Role

As Technical Customer Success Manager for the DACH market, you are the primary point of contact for your customer cohort (of SMBs) once they've signed. You own their success, satisfaction, and retention end to end.

You actively build relationships, identify value drivers, and ensure every customer gets the most out of fonio. You'll spend most of your time in calls and meetings with customers and implementing or improving their setups.

 

What to expect

 * Own a portfolio of DACH SMB customers across their full lifecycle

 * Build relationships, surface value, and find new use cases for AI agents to keep customers engaged

 * Support customers in setting up their AI assistant; implement workflows for medium complex cases and coordinate with developers for advanced setups

 * Run check-ins and proactive calls based on usage signals (low engagement, expansion opportunities, setup friction)

 * Work with a ready-made pipeline and clear playbooks, with room to test your own initiatives

 * Maximize the value generated from each customer in your portfolio

 * Spot churn risks early and act on them

 * Manage your activity autonomously in HubSpot

 

Who We're Looking For

 * 2-5 years in Customer Success, Account Management, Forward Deployment Engineer or a technical client-facing SaaS/B2B role

 * Ideally a strong technical understanding - comfortable understanding API documentation and error logs to troubleshoot customer setup issues independently

 ** Experience with tools like n8n, http://make.com/, codex or similar

 * An affinity for tech / AI products is a real plus

 * strong English

 * Structured, autonomous, results-driven

 * You build trust easily with customers, by phone or video

 * You take initiative, test, iterate, and don't wait to be told what to do

 * Comfortable with CRM (ideally HubSpot) and data-driven workflows

 * Willing to relocate to Vienna for 1-2 months initially

 

What We Offer

 * €60,000-80,000 OTE

 * Equity: you help build it, you should own a piece of it

 * Equipment of your choice

 * A product that sells itself and that customers love (4.5 stars on Trustpilot, Google, and OMR)

 * Regular team offsites

 * Office in Vienna, onsite, in an ambitious team that wants to do the most exciting work of their careers

 

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 20 min culture call with our Founders

1 Lead Advisor/AI-Native Engineering Your Tasks
 * Introduce AI-assisted engineering into client teams and make it stick - coding assistants, agents, spec-driven development.
 * Design guardrails for coding agents: scoped permissions, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, review and CI gates that agent-generated code can't bypass.
 * Keep quality high where agents are in the loop - definition of done for agent output, tests and static analysis as the real safety net, review practices that catch plausible-but-wrong code.
 * Run agents economically - right-sized context and models per task, no runaway loops, cost tracked per outcome.
 * Assess AI readiness at delivery level and map legacy systems onto realistic replacement paths.
 * Independently facilitate Big Picture Event Storming and technical workshops with CTOs, architects, and development teams.
 * Help evolve SQUER's "AI in the SDLC" offering and spot follow-up engagement potential in running projects.

Your Qualifications
 * Several years of development experience, including a lead or senior role with real ownership of a system or a team.
 * AI-assisted coding on a complex project, professional or private - describable with tool, scope, and outcome.
 * Own AI practice beyond ChatGPT: own workflows, agents, MCP servers, custom GPTs.
 * Solid understanding of LLMs, agents, and RAG - what each is and when to use it.
 * Hands-on experience putting guardrails around coding agents, and a clear sense of where agentic coding typically goes wrong.
 * Confident in CI/CD, testing, and iterative delivery.
 * Comfortable running a workshop in front of an unfamiliar group.
 * Fluent in German and English - both required.

Your Benefits
Why You'll Love Working at SQUER:

 * Ownership & Responsibility: at SQUER, we believe in empowering our team. In our flat hierarchies, your ideas and actions matter more than titles. Take the reins, make an impact and grow with us.
 * Learn & Grow: Tap into a € 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy. Join and be part of our active tech community through meetups, hackathons and training sessions. Get up to 40h/year additional time off for your personal education.
 * Exciting Challenges & Real Impact: Dive into diverse projects where your work truly makes a difference - for our clients and for SQUER.
 * Flexibility for Performance: Benefit from hybrid work options, flexible hours, workations within the EU, and additional vacation days - giving you the freedom to perform at your best.
 * Tailored Tools for Success: Choose your preferred hardware configuration and leverage our suite of AI tools and licenses (Anthropic, OpenAI, and more) to suit your working style.
 * We Value You: Beyond perks and benefits, we offer a competitive annual salary to recognize your exceptional contributions.
 * Be Part of a Thriving Team Culture: At SQUER, collaboration and connection are at the heart of what we do. Through open communication, shared successes, and meaningful team events - including our annual SQUER offsite - we cultivate a culture where everyone feels valued and inspired to grow together.
 * A Perks-Packed Workplace: Work in a central office with a spacious terrace and BBQ, enjoy free lunch in the office, MyClubs sports membership, and either a free "Wiener Linien" ticket or a partial contribution to the "Klimaticket". Plus, benefit from free massages, referral bonuses, Corporate Benefits, and JobRad. Annual employee presents and a monthly team breakfast add extra value to your work experience.

We believe in transparent and fair compensation. For this role, the annual gross salary ranges between 
€ 75.000 and € 95.000 - the exact placement depends on the seniority level we assess together during the process.
